description: O36 RULED S477: `@xs.append(3)` on `int[1..=2, append]` holding `[1, 2]` is not provable at compile time (a cell's length is not known), so it is checked at run time; past the bound it TRAPS (E-WRITE-INVARIANT-RT, §19.17) before the write — @xs stays 2 long and the handler's next statement never runs (@n stays 0).
rationale: §66.11.7 (O36 RULED S477): "a write whose effect the compiler cannot prove is checked at RUN TIME and TRAPS on violation"; §19.17: "A trap SHALL stop the current unit of execution at the trapping expression"; the check runs before the write, so nothing is written.
